newsitem.title: USA: Sentencing of Alabama mail bomber delayed.
newsitem.headline: Sentencing of Alabama mail bomber delayed.

text.p: Sentencing of the man who masterminded a wave of mail bombings in the South in 1989 was postponed indefinitely Monday, court officials said.
Walter Leroy Moody Jr. was due to appear for sentencing at 9:30 a.m. EST in Jefferson County Circuit Court. He faced a possible death sentence for the murder of a federal judge in Alabama.
"There's a lot of information that has to be compiled by the probation office and we do not have enough to sentence," judge's assistant Sue Hall told Reuters.
